hints.title: Independent Sort Orders
hints.text: The two columns need to be sorted independently: the first column ascending and the second column descending.

hints.title: Generate Positional Ranks
hints.text: Use window functions to assign row numbers to each column ordered by their respective sorting requirements.

hints.title: Join on Positional Index
hints.text: Join the two ranked single-column relations on their matching row number.

hints.title: Complete SQL Query
hints.text:
```sql
WITH c1 AS (
    SELECT first_col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_col ASC) AS rn
    FROM Data
),
c2 AS (
    SELECT second_col, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY second_col DESC) AS rn
    FROM Data
)
SELECT c1.first_col, c2.second_col
FROM c1
JOIN c2 ON c1.rn = c2.rn;
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) query execution and joins
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A standard table order sorts entire rows together rather than ordering individual columns independently.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Assigning row numbers requires O(N log N) sorting for each column and O(N) memory to store the joined rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Demonstrate window functions (ROW_NUMBER) to decouple and realign column vectors.
